exploratory_year_bootstrap.scope: Exploratory whole-year resampling; only three years per era. Conditional on fixed masks, sensors and observed years; not a causal interval.

interpretation: Observed proximity gap change and recent-control residual screening; not a causal reclamation effect

extended_timeline.scope: Fixed original land cohorts; additional per-date land screening; complete summers with equal months and equal years

satellite_feature_experiment.primary_temporal_scope: Fixed pre-observation map; may be stale
satellite_feature_experiment.retrospective_scope: Fixed 2023 annual map for all dates; not an operational forecast evaluation
satellite_feature_experiment.surroundings: Circular center-excluding rings at 240/480m; >=80% of full window reliable
satellite_feature_experiment.native_variation: QA-masked reflectance at native 10/20m; >=80% valid samples/edges within cell
satellite_feature_experiment.algorithm: Original HistGradientBoostingRegressor, unchanged parameters and seed
satellite_feature_experiment.model_selection: Predefined ablations; no tuning or winner chosen from outer tests
satellite_feature_experiment.support: Primary ablations share full-added-feature marginal ranges; joint overlap unverified
limitations: No thermal predictors or held-out thermal neighbors
Annual cover is classified and needs local checks
Original 13-variant inspection stability is separate from these feature ablations
